capabilities: Render Desmos graphs from desmos-graph code blocks
Graph multiple LaTeX equations per block
Set graph bounds, dimensions, grid, and degree mode
Style equations with colors, line styles, and restrictions
Cache rendered graphs to the filesystem for offline use and PDF export
extras: PDF export requires filesystem caching to be on, all target graphs to be cached, and the renderer disabled; Desmos itself does not support equation labels.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render interactive or cached Desmos graphs inside notes.

relations.evidence: Render Desmos graphs right inside your notes. Works both online and offline.

summary: Graph renderer that embeds Desmos graphs in notes via a desmos-graph code block with LaTeX equations, bounds, and per-equation styling.
